subject: Onyx Logistics: supplier portal invite failed due to email alias
messages:
From: Jose Ramos <j.ramos@onyxlogistics.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trouble accepting supplier portal invite (Onyx Logistics)

Hi Kimberly,

We received the invite to Redwood's Coupa portal but when I click the link it redirects to our corporate alias (j.ramos@onyxlogistics.co) and then fails with a 403. IT says the invite landed on an address alias that is not configured to accept external invites.

Steps we've tried:
- Cleared browser cache and tried incognito
- Clicked invite from two different devices
- Confirmed the invite went to j.ramos@onyxlogistics.com (not .co) in the email header

I attached a screenshot of the error. Can your side reissue the invite to the .com address explicitly or advise the required acceptance flow? We're blocked from submitting the W-9.

Thanks,
Jose Ramos
Vendor Admin, Onyx Logistics
procurement@onyxlogistics.com

Attachment: InviteError.png (image/png)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Jose Ramos <j.ramos@onyxlogistics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trouble accepting supplier portal invite (Onyx Logistics)

Hi Jose — thanks for the screenshot, that helped. A couple quick notes and next steps from our side: 

1) How you received it: Coupa will send to the exact email address used on the invitation. If your identity provider (IdP) has a forwarding/alias rule (e.g., @onyxlogistics.co) it can cause the SSO handoff to pick the wrong principal.

2) Immediate workaround: I can manually resend an invite and force the email to the .com address and mark it as "non-SSO" so it uses the email acceptance flow rather than your IdP redirect.

3) Long-term: we should map your IdP attribute for mail (or the eduPersonPrincipalName field) to ensure the Coupa tenant recognizes the .com principal. I've looped in Marissa (vendor ops) and David (SSO) to coordinate the tenant mapping and to confirm whether your invite landed on a duplicate alias.

Action items:
- Marissa: can you reissue the invite to j.ramos@onyxlogistics.com with the non-SSO flag and upload the W-9 stub so Jose can complete onboarding?
- David: can you check the tenant user mapping for onyxlogistics.com vs onyxlogistics.co and confirm whether we should add an explicit alias mapping?

Jose — I'll follow up as soon as I have confirmation. If you can share the header of the invite email (full Received/Delivered-To lines) that will speed debugging.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Manager, Vendor Onboarding
Redwood Inference

Got it — I reissued the invite as requested. Notes:
- I toggled the "force email acceptance" flag on the Coupa invite so it won't redirect into SSO for the first acceptance.
- Uploaded a placeholder W-9 (Onyx asked us to pre-fill so their admin can confirm quickly) to their Coupa profile so they can finish the setup immediately after accepting.
- Attached the new invite link and a short acceptance checklist.

New invite link: https://app.coupa.com/invite/ABC123-onx (expires in 7 days)
Acceptance checklist (short):
- Click the invite link, choose "Accept"
- Enter company details + upload signed W-9 (or confirm pre-filled)
- Confirm ACH details or PO contact

Attachment: Onyx-W9.pdf (application/pdf)

Marissa

Redwood Inference
